messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "includes dietary changes and taking calcium and vitamin supplements"
set: ["includes dietary changes and taking calcium and vitamin supplements", "ask doctor about bone density scan or calcium and vitamin D supplement", "learn about foods to eat for enough calcium and vitamin D in diet", "treatment program includes diet, exercise, and weight control", "tell doctor about all medicines including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements", "switching back and forth changes actual medicine received", "stop taking and call doctor right away", "stop taking and call doctor right away if unusual changes in mood or behavior", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "stop taking and tell doctor right away if pregnant", "stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test", "stop taking and call doctor at once if symptoms occur", "monitor for increased calcium", "store between 4°C and 30°C (39°F and 86°F)"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
